target_roles.title: VP of Product Development
target_roles.rationale: Mimaki's explicit positioning around 'industry's best outdoor color durability' and partnership with 3M's MCS Warranty Program shows product differentiation is core to their competitive strategy. This role owns the product roadmap and decides which consumables, accessories, and solutions get bundled or recommended with their printer systems. Tedlar directly enables them to strengthen their outdoor durability claims, extend warranty coverage, reduce customer warranty claims from fading/cracking, and differentiate their eco-solvent and UV printer offerings in a competitive market. With Mimaki winning 2025 Pinnacle Awards and actively launching new models like the JV200 Series, the VP Product Development would be measured on market differentiation, customer satisfaction scores, and warranty claim reduction—all areas where Tedlar's 12-20+ year lifespan and UV protection provide quantifiable advantage. Given Mimaki's focus on outdoor applications and vehicle wraps, recommending Tedlar as the premium overlaminate solution would directly support their premium positioning and could become a competitive moat.

target_roles.title: Director of Marketing
target_roles.rationale: Mimaki's active presence at ISA Sign Expo and PRINTING United Expo, coupled with their recent facility expansion and 25-year anniversary messaging, indicates aggressive go-to-market activity. The Director of Marketing owns messaging around product durability, competitive positioning, and customer-facing value propositions. Tedlar enables powerful marketing claims: '20+ year outdoor graphics protection,' 'graffiti-proof vehicle wraps,' and 'maintenance-free architectural graphics.' With Mimaki's customers in vehicle wraps, outdoor signage, and architectural graphics facing constant durability complaints and warranty issues, partnering with Tedlar gives Marketing concrete proof points for trade show messaging, sales collateral, and customer success stories. This role is measured on market share growth, brand perception, and lead generation—all improved by positioning Mimaki as the durability leader. The recent expansion into Flowery Branch with an enlarged showroom suggests they're investing heavily in customer experience, making Tedlar demonstrations and durability testing natural showroom content that drives conversions.

target_roles.title: Director of Sales
target_roles.rationale: Mimaki's distribution model through dealers and direct sales to print service providers means the Director of Sales is accountable for revenue growth, dealer satisfaction, and closing enterprise accounts. Sales reps constantly face objections around total cost of ownership, durability concerns, and competitive pressure from lower-cost alternatives. Offering Tedlar as a recommended overlaminate solution gives sales teams a defensible premium story: instead of competing on printer price alone, they can sell a complete durability system with quantifiable ROI (fewer reprints, reduced maintenance, extended graphic lifespan). For vehicle wrap shops and outdoor signage companies—Mimaki's core customers—graffiti resistance and 20+ year durability directly translate to lower callbacks and higher customer retention. This role cares about deal velocity, win rates against competitors, and upsell attachment rates. Tedlar becomes an upsell opportunity and competitive differentiator, particularly when pursuing municipal contracts, transit authorities, and fleet graphics customers who prioritize lifecycle cost over initial price. With 160+ employees across multiple training centers, equipping the sales organization with Tedlar's value story directly impacts quota attainment.
